intro.text: A rare people, seldom seen in the Cognitive Realm. They are skilled navigators and much sought after as guides through the Cognitive Realm.

description.text: Little is known of their culture.

Tall and limber, they are roughly human in shape, but have four arms and the eyes of a reptile. Their skin and hair are chalk-white, the hair broad and flat, more like blades of grass than human hair.

items.text: Sho Del at some point settled the planet UTol, and in time human explorers from Komashi, its twin planet, came upon them there.
